requirement.normalizedRequirement: Cargo-residue discharge is permitted only if residue_not_recoverable_by_common_methods = true, ship_en_route = true, harmful_substance_present = false, departure_and_destination_within_Arctic = true, route_remains_within_Arctic = true, adequate_reception_facilities_available = false, and distance_to_nearest_land_ice_shelf_or_fast_ice_nm >= 12; record distance from ice concentration greater than 1/10.
requirement.requiredInputs: Cargo/cleaning-agent classification, voyage route, reception-facility status, and discharge position/ice data
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: Discharge of cargo residues that cannot be recovered using commonly available methods for unloading shall only be permitted while the ship is en route and where all of the following conditions are satisfied: cargo residues, cleaning agents or additives, contained in hold washing water do not include any substances classified as harmful to the marine environment; both the port of departure and the next port of destination are within Arctic waters and the ship will not transit outside Arctic waters between those ports; no adequate reception facilities are available at those ports; and discharge of cargo hold washing water containing residues shall be made as far as practicable from areas of ice concentration exceeding 1/10, but in any case not less than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land, nearest ice shelf, or nearest fast ice.
